content_blocks.label: clause_1._Termination_Notice
content_blocks.text: The Tenant is hereby notified that this tenancy will terminate effective May 15, 2024, due to non-payment of rent as required under the lease agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Rent_Due
content_blocks.text: The Tenant is in arrears for rent payments due on April 15, 2024, and must rectify this situation immediately.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Removal_of_Property
content_blocks.text: If the Tenant has not vacated the premises by the date specified above, the Landlord reserves the right to remove any remaining personal property of the Tenant from the premises.
